## What's new

- Browser extension tagline now matches the app.
- GitHub repository is now `dillionverma/bitlatch`.

## Downloads

- **Desktop:** macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon), Windows (x64), Linux (x64 / ARM64).
- **Extensions:** Chrome / Chromium, Firefox preview, and Raycast source ZIP.

Download packages and checksums from **Assets** below. Requires the official Bitwarden CLI. [Setup](https://github.com/dillionverma/bitlatch#installation).

Preview: macOS is not notarized; Windows is unsigned; Windows and Linux are experimental. Auto-lock defaults to **Never**; change it in Settings.
